cards.target: Quem procura, acha.
cards.english: Whoever seeks, finds.

cards.target: A união faz a força.
cards.english: Unity is strength.

cards.target: Quem ama, cuida.
cards.english: Those who love, care.

cards.target: A mentira tem perna curta.
cards.english: Lies have short legs.

cards.target: Quem planta colhe.
cards.english: You reap what you sow.

cards.target: Ela deixou de responder minhas mensagens.
cards.english: She stopped answering my messages.

cards.target: O maracatu é ritmo e resistência.
cards.english: Maracatu is rhythm and resistance.

cards.target: Tão somente os envolvidos foram notificados.
cards.english: Only those involved were notified.

cards.target: Cachorro que ladra não morde.
cards.english: The dog that barks doesn't bite.

cards.target: A pressa é inimiga da perfeição.
cards.english: Haste is the enemy of perfection.

cards.target: Quem ri por último ri melhor.
cards.english: He who laughs last laughs best.

cards.target: A música popular brasileira é reconhecida mundialmente.
cards.english: Brazilian popular music is recognized worldwide.

cards.target: Entrementes, a população aguardava ansiosa por notícias.
cards.english: Meanwhile, the population anxiously awaited news.

cards.target: Quem semeia vento, colhe tempestade.
cards.english: Whoever sows the wind, reaps the whirlwind.

cards.target: Eis que surge uma oportunidade inesperada.
cards.english: Lo and behold, an unexpected opportunity arises.

cards.target: Não lhe assiste razão nessa demanda.
cards.english: He is not right in this claim.

cards.target: A batucada é o coração do samba.
cards.english: The drumming is the heart of samba.

cards.target: Inobstante as ressalvas, o parecer foi favorável.
cards.english: Despite the reservations, the opinion was favorable.

cards.target: Grassa entre os especialistas um debate acalorado.
cards.english: A heated debate prevails among the experts.

cards.target: O panorama socioeconômico atual demanda respostas inovadoras.
cards.english: The current socioeconomic landscape demands innovative responses.

cards.target: O axé é a energia que move a Bahia.
cards.english: Axé is the energy that moves Bahia.

cards.target: O fenômeno em tela suscita reflexões de ordem filosófica.
cards.english: The phenomenon at hand raises philosophical reflections.

cards.target: O chimarrão une os gaúchos em qualquer lugar do mundo.
cards.english: Chimarrão unites gaúchos anywhere in the world.

cards.target: Encerra-se, assim, o presente capítulo.
cards.english: Thus, the present chapter comes to a close.

cards.target: Avultam as críticas ao modelo econômico vigente.
cards.english: Criticism of the current economic model looms large.

cards.target: A corda sempre arrebenta do lado mais fraco.
cards.english: The rope always breaks on the weaker side.

cards.target: Nada obstante as adversidades, perseverou em seu intento.
cards.english: Notwithstanding the adversities, he persevered in his intent.

cards.target: Tamanha era sua dedicação que todos o admiravam.
cards.english: Such was his dedication that everyone admired him.

cards.target: De grão em grão, a galinha enche o papo.
cards.english: Grain by grain, the hen fills its crop.

cards.target: O samba é a trilha sonora da alma brasileira.
cards.english: Samba is the soundtrack of the Brazilian soul.

cards.target: A diversidade religiosa é uma marca da sociedade brasileira.
cards.english: Religious diversity is a hallmark of Brazilian society.

cards.target: As comunidades quilombolas preservam a história da resistência negra.
cards.english: Quilombo communities preserve the history of Black resistance.

cards.target: A despeito de tudo quanto lhe disseram, manteve-se firme.
cards.english: Despite everything they told him, he stood firm.

cards.target: Atento às demandas da sociedade, o legislador propôs alterações.
cards.english: Attentive to society's demands, the legislator proposed changes.

cards.target: Ora, não é de se estranhar que as pessoas desconfiem.
cards.english: Well, it's not surprising that people are suspicious.

cards.target: Impende observar que os prazos foram respeitados.
cards.english: It must be noted that the deadlines were met.

cards.target: A capoeira nasceu da resistência do povo negro.
cards.english: Capoeira was born from the resistance of Black people.

cards.target: É de pequenino que se torce o pepino.
cards.english: As the twig is bent, so the tree grows.

cards.target: Caberia indagar se os meios justificam os fins.
cards.english: One might ask whether the means justify the ends.

cards.target: Outrossim, impõe-se a observância estrita dos prazos estipulados.
cards.english: Furthermore, strict observance of the stipulated deadlines is required.

cards.target: O cordel é a poesia que nasce do povo.
cards.english: Cordel is the poetry that comes from the people.

cards.target: O candomblé é uma religião que preserva tradições ancestrais africanas.
cards.english: Candomblé is a religion that preserves ancestral African traditions.

cards.target: A viola caipira é o som do interior do Brasil.
cards.english: The viola caipira is the sound of rural Brazil.

cards.target: A saudade é um sentimento que só existe em português.
cards.english: Saudade is a feeling that only exists in Portuguese.

cards.target: A roda de samba é onde o brasileiro encontra sua essência.
cards.english: The samba circle is where Brazilians find their essence.

cards.target: Há que se ponderar os prós e os contras antes de decidir.
cards.english: One must weigh the pros and cons before deciding.

cards.target: Mais vale prevenir do que remediar.
cards.english: Prevention is better than cure.

cards.target: Quem com ferro fere, com ferro será ferido.
cards.english: He who lives by the sword dies by the sword.

cards.target: Em casa de ferreiro, o espeto é de pau.
cards.english: In a blacksmith's house, the skewer is made of wood.

cards.target: De sorte que não reste dúvida, reiterarei minha posição.
cards.english: So that no doubt remains, I will reiterate my position.

cards.target: Não me consta que tal decisão tenha sido tomada.
cards.english: I'm not aware that such a decision has been made.

cards.target: À revelia do que fora combinado, ele mudou os planos.
cards.english: Contrary to what had been agreed, he changed the plans.

cards.target: O Dia de Finados é uma data de reflexão e saudade.
cards.english: All Souls' Day is a day of reflection and longing.

cards.target: As festas de Parintins são um espetáculo de cores e cultura.
cards.english: The Parintins festival is a spectacle of colors and culture.

cards.target: A mandioca é a base da culinária de muitas regiões brasileiras.
cards.english: Cassava is the foundation of cuisine in many Brazilian regions.

cards.target: Destaca-se, nesse ínterim, a atuação exemplar da equipe.
cards.english: In the meantime, the exemplary performance of the team stands out.

cards.target: Não fossem as circunstâncias, teria agido de outra forma.
cards.english: Were it not for the circumstances, I would have acted differently.

cards.target: O frevo é a alma do Carnaval de Recife e Olinda.
cards.english: Frevo is the soul of the Carnival in Recife and Olinda.

cards.target: O coco verde na praia é um símbolo do verão brasileiro.
cards.english: Green coconut at the beach is a symbol of Brazilian summer.

cards.target: Oxalá as gerações futuras colham os frutos do que plantamos hoje.
cards.english: May future generations reap the fruits of what we plant today.

existing_tips: Literally 'a scalded cat is afraid of cold water'.
Famous prophecy attributed to Antônio Conselheiro – about transformation.
